select r.id id,r.re_id reId,r.re_name feeReName,r.survey_org_id surveyOrgId,r.survey_org_name surveyOrgName, r.survey_user_id surveyUserId,r.survey_user_name surveyUserName,r.re_state reState,r.re_state_str reStateName,r.reject_desc rejectDesc, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(c.id,',',s.survey_case_no,',',s.survey_person,',',s.entrust_org_id,',',s.entrust_org_name,',',DATE_FORMAT(c.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'),',',d.Investigator_re_money) separator '_') lineStr, CASE pr.state WHEN 1 THEN '待提交财务审核' WHEN 2 THEN '待财务审核' WHEN 3 THEN '报销完成' WHEN 4 THEN '财务审核驳回' ELSE '' END preStateName from investigator_re_info r left join investigator_re_details d on r.id = d.investigator_re_id left join survey_risk_case_info c on d.survey_info_id = c.id left join survey_risk_case s on c.survey_id = s.id LEFT JOIN investigator_pre_details p ON p.investigator_case_id = d.investigator_case_id LEFT JOIN survey_pre_reimbursement pr ON p.investigator_re_id = pr.id where 1 = 1

desc,
